packageRules.description: Python minor/major bumps must change pyproject.toml, poetry.lock, the Dockerfile and every workflow together. Renovate can't regenerate poetry.lock for a Python bump, so group them into one PR that is only created when approved on the Dependency Dashboard.
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** Renovate cannot update `poetry.lock` for a Python bump. Check that py-cord (and davey) support the new version, run `poetry lock` on this branch and push it, and update the Python version in `tests/e2e/README.md`.

packageRules.description: Keep Python patch bumps of the Docker base image as their own PR, so a pending minor bump doesn't hold them back.
